meta.name: Pluto TV Drama
meta.description:
On Pluto TV Drama, serious film is taken... seriously. Some of best cinematic dramas of all time can be experienced here, in all their angsty, gritty, sometimes heartbreaking, sometimes heartwarming glory.

Shows: School Ties, The Truman Show, Indecent Proposal, Varsity Blues, Fat Man and Little Boy
Available on: Pluto TV
